content:
We are looking for an experienced and performance-driven Admission Team Lead to lead our Academic Counselling and Admissions team at our Design Institute.

The ideal candidate should have proven experience in leading an academic counselling or admissions team, driving student enrolments, managing admission targets, and ensuring a structured and professional counselling process. Candidates with prior experience in a Design Institute or creative education environment will be given preference.

Bala Karaiya Mayank Verma Kalyan Raman Manovanchhit Dubey
comment: In admissions, the strongest teams often balance enrolment goals with long-term student fit. A structured counselling process helps avoid short-term conversions that later impact retention and outcomes.
